main_text.p: 2.Sam.5.12 &c. Hiph. והשיאו Et faciant aut finant fer-re, Levit.23.16. והשיא Et attolli vel affortari curabunt, 1.Sam.17.15. Hithp. Praeter. התנשא Efferret fe, Ezech. 17.14. Part. מתנשא Efferens fe, 1.Reg 1.5. Infin. נהתנשא Efferendo te, Prov.30.32. &c. Chald. Particip. foemin. מתנשאה Extollens fe, Eft.4.19.

נשיא m. Princeps, quasi Elatus super alios, Levit.4.22. Conftr. נשיא אלהים Princeps Dei, Gen.23.6. Plural. נשיאים Principes,Gen.17.20. Item,Vapores, Nubes,quia e terra in sublime attolluntur, & aere ventos portantur, scribit Aben Esra Prov.25.14. נשיאים ויעלה [?] ut afcendere facit nubes, Jerem.10.13. Conftruct. נשיאי מטות Principes tribuum, Numer.1.16. Affix. נשיאיה Principes ejus, Ezech.32.29.
שׁ mafc. Excellentia, Elatio : Aff. שיאו Excellentia ejus, Job.20.6.

שׂאת f. Excellentia, Gen.49.3. Tumor, Lev.13.2. Remiffio, Condonatio, Genef.4.7. ולשאת Et tumori ifti, Lev.14.56. Aff. שאתו Excellentia ejus, Job.13.11. משאתו De excellentia ejus, Pfal 62.5. Et contracte, משאו Ab excellentia ejus, Job.41.16. Eft & Infinitivus Kal.

משא m. Onus, à Tollendo ac Ferendo dictum ; Prophetia, proprie onerofa, calamitatum ac poenarum onus denuncians, Jef.13.1. Elatio, res ad quam Attollitur vel levatur animus, Ezech.24.25. Aff. ואל משאו Et in onere fuo, Num.4.19. Foemin. משאה Onus vel Incendium, juxta Ab.Efram, Jef.30.27. fic dictum, quod furfum fe Effert; Ferculum, à Ferendo, juxta Chaldaum & Hebraos, Genef.43.34. 2.Sam.11.8. Colleãa, quasi Elevationem pecunia dicas, 2.Paralip.24.9. Conftr. משאת כפי Elatio manuum

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are only partly legible at this scan resolution; consonants are copied as seen. The form ויעלה in the Jerem.10.13 entry is doubtful and marked [?]. The lone שׁ headword before "mafc." is printed without its full vowel pointing and may be read differently. "Sa-muel" is a printed line-end hyphen. The Latin "Elatio manuum" closing the last entry is on its own line in the print, set in italic.
